decisions.reason: As a flagship organic sliced salami line with several variants that matches the firm's stated expansion in organic charcuterie, it is very likely to remain in the assortment.
This organic poultry snack stays close to the firm's core convenience-meat offer and supports demand for lighter, ingredient-conscious options, so continuation is more likely than withdrawal.
The premium sharing salami line broadens the range within established salami strengths and suits a broad-assortment strategy, making retention the likelier choice.
Although newer and somewhat easier to prune as a single SKU, the organic boiled sausage fits the firm's bio expansion and classic cold-cut competence, so it is still more likely to be kept.
The organic thin-sliced chicken breast line adds multiple variants in a growing organic deli segment and aligns well with household demand for convenient premium cold cuts.

This organic herb-coated salami is a close extension of the firm's salami expertise and organic strategy, though as a more niche flavor variant it carries a somewhat higher discontinuation risk than the core lines.
